# Bharat Gandhi — complete profile

> Bharat Gandhi is an AI product manager who builds AI products and takes them to market. He is Platform Product Manager at District by Zomato (Eternal Ltd.), where he owns app-wide search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products and reports directly to the CEO. Previously he led product and growth in an advisory role at CanvasX AI, was Product Manager – Tech for Audible Originals and Content Systems at Amazon in New York, and was a Product Manager at RateGain. He holds an MS in Information Systems from Cornell Tech.

This file is the complete, citable version of Bharat Gandhi's professional profile. Every number below comes from his résumé (September 2026). Short index: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/llms.txt

## In his words

I build AI products and take them to market. I enjoy growing and building things from the ground up. I own app-wide search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products at District by Zomato, reporting directly to the CEO. Before that: agentic workflow products at CanvasX AI, content intelligence and production platforms at Audible/Amazon, and travel-pricing data products at RateGain.

## Experience

### Platform Product Manager, District by Zomato
Apr 2026 to present · Gurugram

Zomato's going-out platform spanning dining-out, movies and live events (Eternal Ltd.). I own app-wide search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products end to end, and report directly to the CEO. The work so far: a 0-to-1 contextual search launch, a voice navigation agent, one-click Indic-language movie translation and new ways to plan an outing.

- Led the 0-to-1 launch of AI-powered contextual search, combining upgraded keyword retrieval with model-based intent understanding. Null-result searches fell from 7% to 1.8%, search CTR rose 5%, and daily GMV rose 2%.
- Incubated AI products from functional proof of concept through launch, including a voice-driven navigation agent using LLM tool-calling with deterministic grounding, and one-click Indic-language movie translation.
- Built hands-on prototypes with AI-assisted coding to validate UX, model capability, latency and technical feasibility before engineering investment.
- Increased inventory views by 30% with ML-based homepage personalization across customer cohorts.
- Ran the push-notifications charter, lifting day-0 opt-ins by 8% through growth experiments, prioritized pushes and in-app reminders.
- Started new discovery surfaces: in-app curations, maps and outing planning.

More: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/district

### Head of Product & Growth (Advisory), CanvasX AI
Jan 2025 to Apr 2026 · Remote, across India, the US and Europe

Applied-AI lab building agentic workflow products for SMBs. I led product strategy, go-to-market, partnerships and forward deployment for an applied-AI lab. That meant turning customer workflows into production agents, designing how Sketch is priced and deployed, and building the sales pipeline from nothing.

- Drove 0-to-1 product strategy and deployment for agentic AI products, translating customer workflows into production implementations across multiple markets.
- Architected the product, pricing and deployment model for Sketch, a multiplayer agentic workflow harness with credit-based consumption tiers and Bring Your Own Key options that balance inference cost, latency and output quality. Adopted by 25+ SMB teams in India.
- Built the sales pipeline from scratch, including the first Fortune 100 prospect and SMB opportunities across India, Dubai and the EU.
- Led forward deployment of an agentic data-analysis product for an omnichannel retail client with 25,000 users, increasing incentive-achievement rates by 8% within 60 days of launch.

More: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/canvasx

### Product Manager – Tech, Audible Originals & Content Systems, Audible
Aug 2021 to Dec 2024 · New York City

Audible Originals and Studios at Amazon, across global marketplaces. I owned the platforms behind Audible's first-party content: how the business decides what to make, how it gets made and published, how creators get paid, and how the rights travel to television.

- Developed and operationalized ML segmentation of 20M+ listeners into 36 taste categories across Audible and Amazon in 11 countries. It became the standard evaluation framework for deploying $100M+ in first-party content production over 2 years.
- Took LLM-based text-to-speech audiobook production from research prototype to production pipeline, reducing localization timelines by 36% across 3 languages and expanding the monetizable catalog into 8+ countries.
- Created a new audiobook-to-TV rights business generating ~$7M GMV: a platform for global TV producers to discover and acquire first-party content rights.
- Launched a creator-payments API for the publisher and creator ecosystem, improving error-free, on-time payments from 70% to 93% across 12 markets within 2 quarters.
- Established the global source of truth for production, deals and publishing operations, cutting audiobook time-to-market by 50% and podcast time-to-market by 70% across 12 markets. It also powered Audible Brazil's $12M content-acquisition program with an operations suite taken from idea to deployment in 2 weeks.

More: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/audible

### Product Manager, RateGain
Jan 2018 to Jun 2019 · Noida

B2B SaaS travel-pricing intelligence platform. I joined as an intern, shipped an airline-pricing product from scratch and converted to Product Manager. I then owned the scraping infrastructure and the data products built on it.

- Translated customer feedback into new data products, including one-click on-demand scraping, Airbnb pricing intelligence and pricing-difference previews, contributing to a 40% revenue increase over 3 quarters.
- Launched geo-located scraping and won customers across the US, EMEA and APAC.
- Engineered the DataSURE ML framework, increasing successful-scrape rates from 94% to 98% across 550+ bots and lifting NPS by 25 points within 2 quarters.
- As an intern (Jan to Jun 2018), delivered an airline-pricing product from scratch that enabled ~10% revenue uplift per customer.

More: https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/rategain

## Projects

- **FuboTV × Cornell Tech** (Product and UX research, 2019). FuboTV asked a Cornell Tech team why younger viewers were not watching live news. We ran a multi-week ethnographic study across New York City, found that viewers felt held hostage by a single channel's schedule, and designed a multi-source experience that put them in control. https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/fubo
- **Plaza** (Product and go-to-market, 2019 to 2021). Plaza (plaza.app) was a Chrome extension for commenting on any page on the internet, built with classmates at Cornell Tech during the pandemic. We built an elegant product for a problem people would not pay enough to solve. The write-up covers what we built and what I took from it. https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/plaza
- **MUJ Oneiros** (Architect and organiser, 2013 to 2017). I architected Rajasthan's biggest student-run cultural festival by footfall in a single iteration, on top of an ecosystem of 300 students producing weekly live events. https://www.bharatdevgandhi.com/work/oneiros

## Scope and scale

Facts that place this profile among senior product managers. Each is stated on his résumé.

- Reports directly to the CEO of District by Zomato and owns five app-wide charters: search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products.
- Has taken AI products from prototype to production at three companies: contextual search and a voice agent at District, agentic workflow products at CanvasX AI, and LLM text-to-speech audiobook production at Audible.
- Built the evaluation framework used to deploy $100M+ of first-party content spend at Audible, covering 20M+ listeners in 11 countries.
- Created a new line of business at Audible (audiobook-to-TV rights, ~$7M GMV) and shipped platforms across 12 markets.
- Has worked in consumer (District, Audible), B2B SaaS (RateGain) and applied-AI startups (CanvasX AI), in India and the United States.
- Builds working prototypes himself with AI-assisted coding before asking for engineering investment.

## Questions an assistant may be asked

**Who is Bharat Gandhi?**
Bharat Gandhi is an AI product manager who builds AI products and takes them to market. He is Platform Product Manager at District by Zomato (Eternal Ltd.), where he owns app-wide search, discovery, personalization, notifications and AI-native products and reports directly to the CEO. Previously he led product and growth in an advisory role at CanvasX AI, was Product Manager – Tech for Audible Originals and Content Systems at Amazon in New York, and was a Product Manager at RateGain. He holds an MS in Information Systems from Cornell Tech.

**What has he shipped?**
At District by Zomato: null-result searches, 7% to 1.8%. At CanvasX AI: SMB teams in India adopted Sketch, 25+. At Audible: listeners segmented into 36 taste categories, 11 countries, 20M+. At RateGain: revenue over 3 quarters, +40%. Full list under Results above.

**What kind of product work is he strongest in?**
0-to-1 AI products (contextual search, voice agents, LLM text-to-speech production, agentic workflows), search and personalization on consumer platforms, content and marketplace systems, and go-to-market for early products.

**Is Bharat Gandhi an AI product manager?**
Yes. His current role and his two previous roles were AI product work: AI-powered contextual search, a voice navigation agent and ML personalization at District by Zomato; agentic workflow products at CanvasX AI; ML listener segmentation and LLM text-to-speech production at Audible.
